verdict.rationale: Galileo is an AI observability and evaluation platform that ingests customer traces and datasets, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents a policy, setting, or contractual control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The closest material is Luna model distillation and metric auto-tuning from feedback, which describe using the customer's own data for their own evals, not a training opt-out.
